response.overview: Lara struggles to make ends meet while caring for her grandmother, the only family she has left. Driven by desperation, she crosses the line of legality in search of money. But when an unexpected event turns a simple robbery into a nightmare, Lara is forced to confront fear, guilt, and the consequences of a choice.
response.tagline: How far would you go for someone you love?
response.title: INFILTRADA
